summary.en: Virgil's Latin epic in twelve books about Aeneas, a Trojan who flees the fall of Troy and reaches Italy, where his descendants will found Rome.

media.title: The Aeneid
media.creator: In Our Time, with Edith Hall, Philip Hardie and Catharine Edwards
media.why: Virgil's own epic, and why Augustan Rome needed it

media.title: The Aeneid, in Dryden's translation
media.why: Book VI is the descent to the underworld that Dante builds on
